title: DaVinci Resolve 20.2 Immersive Video Workflows: VR180 Export, Apple Immersive, and Fusion 3D FX in Depth
summary: This in-depth tutorial surveys DaVinci Resolve 20.2’s leap into immersive video, covering cross-camera workflows (URSA Cine Immersive with Canon VR), VR180 export, and Fusion-driven 3D VFX. It demonstrates converting 360 footage to Apple Immersive 180 lens space via Panomap with camera metadata, ingesting mixed- stereo sources, previewing in the Apple Vision Pro, rotoscoping and paint fixes in 3D, and assembling logos and motion graphics directly into immersive space. The guide also reviews horizon leveling, World Pose post-fixes, and the VR180 delivery options (including high per-eye resolutions) that enable production-quality immersive storytelling on platforms like YouTube VR and Meta Quest.
